why: Phase 6.43 and 6.44 changed use-terminal.ts, so the previous release evidence described a binary that predates them. This record re-measures the gate on a release binary that contains those fixes.

remote.fixture: ephemeral isolated HOME + localhost OpenSSH sshd, key authentication

limitations: This is automated evidence. It does not cover a human on a physical keyboard, Chinese IME composition, Option/dead keys, or vim/nano editing.
Real lid-close sleep/wake, VPN and cellular handover recovery remain unobserved on hardware; the wake recovery paths are covered by frontend regressions only.
The binary is unsigned and unnotarised; first-launch Gatekeeper behaviour on a clean machine is still unverified.
Windows OpenSSH Agent, Pageant, ConPTY/local Windows PTY and serial hardware have no test machine available and are not covered here.
supersedes: the bef9cc8f measurement in this file's earlier revision
instrumentationCaveat: This binary is built with VITE_TERMINAL_SMOKE_BUILD=1, which compiles the smoke and input-probe entry points and the experiments nav item into the frontend. A shipping build omits all of them. The numbers below therefore describe a slightly larger bundle than a user receives, and the startup times are a conservative upper bound rather than a shipping measurement. A shipping-only build of the same source tree (ae3442c5…) measured 3368-3440ms local and 1482ms remote, within noise of the instrumented figures; that build cannot run smoke cases and is therefore not the one recorded here.
